title: Unified Component Library
description: Built a scalable design system serving 50+ product teams with consistent patterns and reusable components.
content:
Built a scalable design system serving 50+ product teams with consistent patterns and reusable components.

This project focused on creating a shared visual language, documentation, and component APIs that product teams could adopt with confidence.

title: Wellness Tracking Platform
description: Designed and developed a cross-platform mobile experience that helps users maintain healthy habits.
content:
Designed and developed a cross-platform mobile experience that helps users maintain healthy habits.

The product combines habit tracking, gentle reminders, and clear progress visualization.

title: Sustainable Fashion Marketplace
description: Created a seamless shopping experience for eco-conscious consumers with integrated sustainability metrics.
content:
Created a seamless shopping experience for eco-conscious consumers with integrated sustainability metrics.

Shoppers can compare impact scores and understand the story behind each product.
